cue_policy: Exact text-key + phrase entry; finite actions once per true line visit. Restore establishes bed without replay. No literal actions on choice hover, instruction-only speech, film captions, or UI reflow.

phrases.en: You push it into your coat

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_03.quote_zh: 你的左手抖个不停。你把它塞进外套里按住，像按住别人的手。

quotes.zh_CN: 你的左手抖个不停。你把它塞进外套里按住，像按住别人的手。
quotes.en: Your left hand won't stop shaking. You push it into your coat and hold it there, as if it belonged to someone else.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_04.quote_zh: 然后树木合拢过来，一片白雾横在你面前，低低的，一动不动。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_04.rationale: reduce open wind; short damp foliage brush, optional very small twig tick

quotes.zh_CN: 然后树木合拢过来，一片白雾横在你面前，低低的，一动不动。
quotes.en: Then the trees close in, and a bank of white mist lies across your path, low and still.

cues.phrase: 前方的雾里有东西在动

phrases.zh_CN: 前方的雾里有东西在动
phrases.en: Something moves in the mist ahead

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_05.quote_zh: 前方的雾里有东西在动。你停下。它也停下。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_05.rationale: brief movement ahead then stop all locomotion gestures

quotes.zh_CN: 前方的雾里有东西在动。你停下。它也停下。
quotes.en: Something moves in the mist ahead. You stop. So does it.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_06.quote_zh: 一个人那么高的影子。腰间闪过一点黄铜。

quotes.zh_CN: 一个人那么高的影子。腰间闪过一点黄铜。
quotes.en: A shape, man-high. A glint of brass at its belt.

DLG_PROMPT_WHAT_DO_YOU_DO.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 你会怎么做？
quotes.en: What do you do?

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_CHOICE_HOLD_STILL_1.quote_zh: 你把自己缩得很小。没什么用。

quotes.zh_CN: 你把自己缩得很小。没什么用。
quotes.en: You make yourself very small. It doesn't help.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_CHOICE_HOLD_STILL_2.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 你知道吧，我看得见你。
quotes.en: I can see you, you know.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_CHOICE_STONE_2.quote_zh: 求你别。我今天已经够累了。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_CHOICE_STONE_2.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 求你别。我今天已经够累了。
quotes.en: Please don't. I've had a long day.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_CHOICE_CALL_OUT_1.quote_zh: 一个不值得你扔石头的人。

quotes.zh_CN: 一个不值得你扔石头的人。
quotes.en: Nobody worth throwing anything at.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_07.quote_zh: 一个年轻人从雾里走出来，喘着粗气。头发上别着月桂，腰间挎着信包。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_07.rationale: Two finite damp approach steps; no breath asset added. Stranger stops once arrived.

quotes.zh_CN: 一个年轻人从雾里走出来，喘着粗气。头发上别着月桂，腰间挎着信包。
quotes.en: A young man steps out of the mist, breathing hard. Laurel in his hair, a satchel of letters at his hip.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_08.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 哦。不是鹿啊。
quotes.en: Oh. You're not a deer.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_09.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 谁派你来的？
quotes.en: Who sent you?

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_19.quote_zh: 他递过来一只水壶，壶身上錾着一对黄铜翅膀。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_19.rationale: dull small flask movement and tiny enclosed slosh

quotes.zh_CN: 他递过来一只水壶，壶身上錾着一对黄铜翅膀。
quotes.en: He holds out a flask worked with a pair of brass wings.

quotes.zh_CN: 喝吧。还是热的。
quotes.en: Drink. It's still warm.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_21.quote_zh: 你接过来。手指冷得厉害，黄铜摸上去竟有点烫。

quotes.zh_CN: 你接过来。手指冷得厉害，黄铜摸上去竟有点烫。
quotes.en: You take it. Your fingers are so cold the brass almost burns.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_22.quote_zh: 他注意到了。不等你缩手，他的手就覆上来，连你的手一起握住壶身。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_22.rationale: soft sleeve touch, optional extremely soft flask contact

quotes.zh_CN: 他注意到了。不等你缩手，他的手就覆上来，连你的手一起握住壶身。
quotes.en: He notices. Before you can pull away, his hand closes over yours on the flask.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_23.quote_zh: 圣徒在上。你冷得像块冰。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_23.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 圣徒在上。你冷得像块冰。
quotes.en: Saints. You're freezing.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_24.quote_zh: 他的手带着赶路的热度。他一直握着，直到水壶不再发抖。
DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_24.rationale: faint rattle, if already present, diminishes and stops

quotes.zh_CN: 他的手带着赶路的热度。他一直握着，直到水壶不再发抖。
quotes.en: His hand is hot from the road. He holds on until the flask stops shaking.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_25.quote_zh: 然后他第一次认真地看你。看你的脸，像是想认出什么。

quotes.zh_CN: 然后他第一次认真地看你。看你的脸，像是想认出什么。
quotes.en: Then he looks at you properly, for the first time. At your face, as if he were trying to place it.

DLG_MESSENGER_EDGE_26.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 我们见过吗？
quotes.en: Have we met?

DIALOGUE_CHOOSE_REPLY.rationale: Retain scene bed; no new literal one-shot.

quotes.zh_CN: 你会怎么说？
quotes.en: What do you say?

local_compatibility.policy: Exact latest quote and exact marker; no offset fallback. Modified or newly added prose is intentionally unmapped. Old dog-pursuit and thorn-rules storyline is never restored.
